items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Oh, Joey Davis -- the guy that had the ruckus around for years. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he was a publisher. Joe Davis.

ctx.x: So me, like a dummy, went out and give him the orchestration. About six months later, 'I'd Do Almost Anything For You', by Claude Hopkins, Bob Williams and Joe Davis. So I saw Claude, and I said ...
Oh, Joey Davis -- the guy that had the ruckus around for years.
Yeah, he was a publisher. Joe Davis.
